rankedVisibleOutcomes.outcome: A deliberate low corner shelf turns between its actual two registered ports, with broad stone top volumes and softly eased rock edges; a clear layered side mass gives thickness without exceeding the low-shelf envelope.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.avoid: Awkward folded faces, collapsed inner turn, black triangular intrusions, disconnected pebbles and a tall wall silhouette.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.outcome: Bright cyan/blue top planes and cobalt blue sides retain the palette family, with soft broad highlights and dimensional tone; any lavender pebble accents remain subordinate. All views look like the same material under horizontally neutral world light.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.avoid: Blown white slabs, plastic wet glare, near-black dead flanks, directional ground shadows and noise-like detail.

rankedVisibleOutcomes.outcome: Large purposeful stone divisions, gentle plane changes and optional sparse pebble/vein accents survive at logical cell128 and phone cell32. Details taper or stop before connector zones so the turn belongs to one continuous shelf family.
rankedVisibleOutcomes.avoid: Uniform scratch bars, repeated bead rows, busy microcracks and decoration whose primary effect is join disruption.

hardGates: Measured finite source footprint, ground contacts and full geometry bounds; root/camera/projection/registration and static timing preserved.
Every actual turned port must match the exact approved shelf-middle endpoint geometry, normals, material/albedo field under the correct transform.
All four native facings and independent native/runtime family assemblies must show continuous visible joins without repair, overlap, per-view fit or runtime helper changes.
No local visible cracks, alpha halos, black patches, clipping, seams or unwanted cast shadows on light/gray/dark backgrounds.
reviewRule: Judge actual native and at-use-size pixels plus numeric source evidence. Missing evidence is needs_evidence. Broad finite-area-light residuals may be measured separately, but no numeric tolerance waives a visible local seam. No approval is issued in preparation.
